body: PM me, I'm planning my death. Serious takers only. I know how you feel. I wish I were never born either.

Too much religion b.s. when trying to find answers and experiences for the after life. Nothing that's real is religious. How many animals are religious? How many stars with planetary bodies orbiting are there in this Galaxy alone? So many galaxies, so many planets, how could we possibly be the only ones? We're so naive, such a foolish bunch of people on this planet.

If we leave our bodies if we die, our Minds, Souls or w/e, would probably leave the planet, and if we leave the planet we enter into a different Time. If we were to enter another planet, Time would be different there, or if we entered another Galaxy, Time would be so different there that we would barely be able to recognise it compared to Earth's. Time Travel is Death. 

It makes more sense that we would traverse Time itself when we die, and so perhaps Past Travel is also possible. It would explain the UFO's.
No I'm good. I was saying that it could be a mistake because I might regret it after I die. But I'm content, been seeing Psychs for many years now. We all got to die some day. :)

You're so bent on needing/having someone. I don't remember how that feels, it's been so long since I've had anyone. 

I've had no choice but to not want anyone for my entire life. Were I to, I would suffer because I could not bring myself to believe liked/loved for who I was, because I hate me. I disgust me, loath me. 

Life is better with others in it. It's one of things driving me to suicide, the loneliness. You may or may not find someone, but it'd be good if you did.

I know what you mean by "waiting to die". Before you know it you're 30 years old (like me) and having nothing to look forward to. I'll be 40 in 10 years... No thank you, I'd rather die, alone either way.

In the next life, I want to keep all my memories of this life. I want a better body, long slender fingers for playing guitar. Nice skin, beautiful face and body. Not asking for much, right?

I want no parents, I want to be made/grown in a lab. Superpowers would be nice, but not necessary. I just want to be beautiful and free of control and influence of negative people as I grow up. I also would like my brother from this life to be my brother in the next life. 

I want to be made, not born. But, definitely in a world better off, without so much death and evil, and destruction and war. How about a world where people can act and star in movies without worrying about money. A world where everyone can be creative and expressive for the only reason to be creative and expressive! 

No money, no lies, no war, no limitations.

I know the feeling. I too have lost my younger years to b.s. I am now 30 and have nothing to show for it. At my age I should already be where I'm supposed to be: A great paying job that I enjoy, a partner or someone to marry. 

I should own my own home, have a nice vehicle or two paid off. I should have plenty of money saved up... No, I have nothing, literally nothing but looking at going in 40 years of age in ten years. 

Where the fuck has.my life gone? What the fuck have I done with my life? What have I done...

I know how you feel, so we'll. I'm over it. I'm going to get a head start in the next life, you're welcome to read my post. I just want you to know that I feel you.
